text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High DNS UDP truncation rate observed for az1a resolver path impacting inference service. Alert: dns_udp_truncation_rate > 10% across resolver-proxy pool. Links: [alert], [runbook]

Maya Chen: ack, I'm on it — checking resolver metrics and kvcache churn.

Jack Ortega: seeing lots of EDNS0 truncated responses from upstream 1.2.3.4 -> clients falling back to TCP, which is saturating our connection table. quick grep: `grep "truncated" /var/log/resolver.log | wc -l` -> +1200 in last 5m.

SRE Oncall: impact: p50 latency up ~60ms, p95 up ~400ms, plus ~5% 5xx on inference endpoints for az1a. Customer-facing SLO alerts firing.

Neil Patel: can we shift traffic to another region while we investigate? What's our safe fallback policy?

Maya Chen: initiating gradual regional shift: running `routeshift --service infer --from az1a --to eu-west-2 --pct 30 --reason "dns truncation"` (canary). Monitoring.

Jack Ortega: root cause looks network-y: large UDP replies are being fragmented/truncated. Instances show increased retransmits and TCP fallback churn. Could be MTU/ECMP/path-MTU or upstream resolver behavior.

Alex (infra): Kvcache effects: nodes that get TCP fallback are regenerating caches and amplifying load. I'm kicking the kvcache warmers on 4 hot nodes: `for n in $(nodes); do curl -s http://$n/warm_kv; done`

Customer Success Bot: sending targeted customer notification for impacted customers (3 customers >1% traffic). Template ready: "We're experiencing a regional DNS truncation in us-az1a causing intermittent latency and errors; mitigation in progress, ETA 30-60m."

Maya Chen: canary +30% is live. Initial metrics: error rate dropped by ~1.5% for shifted traffic. Watching for regressions.

Jack Ortega: alternative mitigation: override upstream resolver to provider-b in az1a to avoid the truncated path. I can flip a small cohort via consul kv. Also possible: temporarily reduce EDNS size to avoid fragmentation.

SRE Oncall: agreed, do resolver override for az1a. Also consider reducing resolver timeout so TCP fallback happens earlier but less frequently — tradeoff.

Maya Chen: doing resolver override now: `consul kv put infra/resolver/override provider-b` -> propagation to proxy pool in progress.

Alex (infra): FYI I opened a ticket with upstream provider; they report an internal path causing UDP fragmentation on large EDNS responses, proposing a BGP refresh. ETA provided: ~40m.

Neil Patel: customer impact summary for CS: 3 customers have seen p95 spikes and occasional 5xxs. We'll mark as intermittent and provide the mitigation steps (regional shift + resolver override). CS will send follow-up.

Maya Chen: quick note to runtime team: if you can temporarily drop large EDNS options on our recursive resolvers, that will reduce truncation. Config snippet: `EDNS0_MAX_UDP=1232` (apply carefully).

Jack Ortega: adding quick troubleshooting snippet for the thread:
```
# check truncation rates
curl -s http://metrics/az1a/resolver | jq '.udp_truncation_rate'
# force small edns on a resolver
echo "options edns0 max-udp 1232" > /etc/resolver/conf.d/edns_small.conf && systemctl reload resolver
```

SRE Oncall: Mitigations applied: 1) +30% regional shift to eu-west-2, 2) resolver upstream override to provider-b for az1a, 3) kvcache warmers on hot nodes, 4) CS notifications sent. Monitoring for 15m.

Maya Chen: preparing handoff in 45m if still open. Current status: error rate trending down but still at ~3.2% in az1a (goal <2%).

Neil Patel: I'll take over if it persists. Escalation plan: if >2% after 30m, open networking incident and request upstream BGP refresh/AS path change.

Alex (infra): upstream confirmed they'll attempt BGP path refresh; they advised a brief route flap window. If that happens, be ready to roll back the resolver override.

Maya Chen: handing off to Neil Patel for next shift. Summary for handoff: DNS UDP truncation in az1a -> TCP fallback -> connection storms -> kvcache regen -> inference 5xx/latency. Actions taken listed above. Next steps: monitor for 30m, escalate to networking if not improved. :white_check_mark: :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Neil Patel: ack — taking over the incident. I'll keep the channel updated every 10m or on major change. Adding incident doc note and runbook link.

incident-bot: Incident status updated: investigating -> mitigating. Severity: sev2. Next automated update in 10m or on change.
